text:
maria: Heads-up — customer QA reported their dashboard spikes showing metrics from another org this morning.
aj: wait what, like mixed rows or the whole timeseries?
maria: whole timeseries for a couple widgets. They pasted org id 801, but telemetry shows org 412 tags interleaved.
devon: screenshots? request ids?
maria: https://redwood.internal/console/snap/xyz — has the raw log extract. snippet shows `org_id=801 sample_id=...` then later `org_id=412 sample_id=...` inside same query response.
kevin: could this be a sampling/aggregation job that dropped org context before batching? we recently changed the telemetry pipeline to sharded samplers.
priya: I rolled out the sampler change last week. It sets a `sample_group` header and we route to the sampler pool by hash of sample_group. Maybe the routing key is wrong (uses tenant cookie instead of explicit org header).
samir: I can repro locally by running the aggregator with small batch window. repro steps:
```
curl -H "X-Org-Id: 801" -H "X-Sample-Group: g1" https://telemetry-worker/ingest
curl -H "X-Org-Id: 412" -H "X-Sample-Group: g1" https://telemetry-worker/ingest
# result: aggregated payload contains both orgs under metrics array
```
aj: that's bad. two different orgs collapsing into same aggregated batch and then tagged incorrectly.
sre-bot: deploy: telemetry/sampler v1.3 promoted to canary on telemetry-pool-2 at 2026-03-20T08:35:00Z
kevin: canary context — which header do we use for routing hash? code shows `hash(headers.get("cookie") || headers.get("x-sample-group"))` — cookie is coming from console session and contains owner org when user switches quickly.
priya: ugh. cookie-based fallback was for legacy mobile clients. Should not be used for telemetry routing. I'll open a PR to change router to `hash(headers.get("x-sample-group") + headers.get("x-org-id"))`.
devon: mitigation for now: disable sampler canary or set sampler pool to single-threaded per-org routing. Can we flip canary back quickly?
priya: yes, reverting canary now. will also add strict validation to drop samples where `org_id` != `x-org-id` header.
maria: we should also scan saved dashboards for mixed-org tags — some saved widgets cache query results. If cache keys don't include org, that's another leak vector.
aj: good point. console cache key currently: `dashboard:v1:widget:<widget_id>:query_hash` — missing org scope.
samir: quick patch suggestion: include `org=<org_id>` in cache key, and invalidate last 24h. low risk.
kevin: add migration to invalidate only widgets with windows that overlapped the canary window: `created_at >= 2026-03-13`.
priya: PR up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/842 — fixes router and adds header validation tests.
kevin: thanks. once revert completes, run sampling smoke tests and customer QA repro.
sre-bot: deploy: telemetry/sampler rollback started at 2026-03-20T09:05:12Z
maria: QA confirmed reverted sampler removes cross-org spikes from their dashboard. they want a short blameless postmortem and notification.
aj: agree — add root cause: router used cookie fallback causing sample grouping to ignore explicit org header; missing org in console cache keys allowed stale cross-org values to persist.
devon: action items: 1) telemetry PR merged (priya) 2) console cache key patch + invalidation (samir) 3) run org-scoped smoke tests in canary pipelines (aj) 4) PM note + customer outreach (maria)
priya: I'll merge after CI passes and schedule rollout to stable with 10% canary for 2h.
samir: console cache PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/299 — includes key change + invalidation job.
kevin: add monitoring: alert if any dashboard query returns `multiple_org_ids` in result meta. set severity low but runbook in eng-platform handbook.
maria: thanks all — keep updates here and I'll draft the short notice to affected customers.
priya: postmortem draft will include timeline, root cause, detection, mitigation, and 3 CTAs: remove cookie fallback, add org to caches, add cross-org smoke tests.
aj: nice. can we also add telemetry sampling unit tests simulating interleaved requests to ensure no cross-org mixing?
priya: yes adding that now.
maria: closing loop — confirmed by customer at 2026-03-20T10:23:00Z that dashboard is back to normal. moving to postmortem channel next.
